cohort: 20,038 infants born between 22 and 32 weeks' gestation and admitted to Canadian neonatal intensive care units
finding: Birth route did not have an impact on LOS, but was associated with CONS-related LOS.
mod_finding: This study found that while birth route (vaginal vs. cesarean) did not impact the overall incidence of late-onset sepsis in preterm neonates, cesarean delivery was associated with a higher risk of coagulase-negative Staphylococcal late-onset sepsis.
